segments.song_title: 당신을 파괴하는 순간 (The Moment When I Destroy You)

talks.summary_ko: 추운 날씨 속에서도 공연장을 찾아준 관객들에게 감사의 마음을 전합니다. 이번이 네 번째 공연이라 이제는 환경에 조금 적응되었다며 특별한 추억이 될 것 같다는 소감을 나눕니다.
talks.transcript: 그대의 사랑이 나를 또 살리네. 저의 공연이 여러분을 또 얼리네. 예, 예. 아, 공연에 찾아와 주셔서 너무나 감사합니다. 아주아주 특별한 추억이 될 것 같은데요, 벌써부터? 그래도 뭐 이제 네 번째라고 좀 적응됐습니다. 자 일단,
talks.translation_en: "Your love brings me back to life again." And my concert is freezing you all again. Yeah, yeah. Ah, thank you so much for coming to the concert. I think this will already become a very, very special memory, don't you think? Still, since this is already my fourth show, I've gotten somewhat used to it. Well, first of all,

talks.summary_ko: 선우정아는 이번 공연이 자신을 살려준 곡들을 모아 구성한 무대이며, 자신의 삶을 지탱해 온 음악의 가장 내밀한 첫 시작을 전하고자 피아노 연주로 진행했음을 밝힙니다. 이어 앞서 연주한 곡들의 제목과 함께 지드래곤 월드투어 다큐멘터리를 위해 작업했던 미발매곡 'Blessed Rain'에 얽힌 배경을 설명합니다.
talks.transcript: 콜록적이며 기침하고 부시럭대는 시간 한번 가져볼게요. 예. 아이고. 어 저를 살린 곡들을 모아서 공연을 만들어 보게 됐습니다. 음, 싱어송라이터로 살면서 살면서 겪은 여러 가지 것들을 재료로 노래를 만들고 하다 보니, 음, 이 모든 음악은 결국 그냥 제 삶의 증거 같은 기록 같은 것들이고 이것이 저를 계속 살려오고 있었더라고요. 그런 생각을 하면서 이번 공연을 만들었고요. 가장 좀 내밀한 음악과 저의 첫 시작을, 어떤 곡의 첫 시작을 보여드리고 싶은 마음에 피아노를 치면서 쭉 끌어가게 되었습니다. 'Love Myself', '삐뚤어졌어', '그러려니', '비 온다', 그리고 'Blessed Rain' 들려드렸습니다. 'Blessed Rain'은 제가 프로듀싱하고 부른 곡입니다만, 발매는 되지 않았고요. 유튜브 오리지널 콘텐츠입니다. 2018년에 지드래곤 월드 투어 다큐멘터리로, 를 위해 만든 곡이고요. 그래서 그 안에 삽입이 되어 있고 거기서만 감상하실 수 있습니다.
talks.translation_en: Let’s take a moment for everyone to clear their throats, cough, and rustle around a bit. Yes. (laughs) Oh my. So, I ended up putting together this concert by gathering the songs that kept me alive. As a singer-songwriter, turning the various things I've experienced in life into ingredients to make music, I realized that all this music is ultimately a record and proof of my life, and that it has continually kept me going. That was the thought I had in mind when creating this show. Wanting to share the most intimate beginning between myself and the music—the very starting point of a song—I decided to lead the performance while playing the piano. I just played 'Love Myself', 'Crooked', 'Things Fall Apart', 'Rain is Falling', and 'Blessed Rain' for you. Although I produced and sang 'Blessed Rain', it was never officially released; it is part of a YouTube Original project. It was made in 2018 for G-Dragon's world tour documentary, so it is featured in it and can only be listened to there.

talks.summary_ko: 아티스트는 자신의 곡들 중 각자의 방식으로 가장 찬란하게 빛나는 세 곡을 묶어 연주하겠다고 소개합니다. 화려하고 빛나는 요소들을 사랑하는 본인의 감성을 담아 다음 무대를 열어갑니다.
talks.transcript: 다음 곡들은 제 노래 중에 가장 찬란한 세 곡을 묶어봤습니다. 제가 뭐 다 찬란하고 뭐 빛이 어쩌고 이런 걸 많이 좋아하는데, 그중에서도 특히 각자의 방식으로 가장 찬란한 것 같아요.
talks.translation_en: For the next part, I put together three songs of mine that shine the most brilliantly. I naturally love things that are dazzling, full of light, and so on, but among them, these three songs feel the most radiant in their own unique ways.

talks.summary_ko: 다음으로 부를 미발매곡 '자장'은 세상을 떠난 이를 생각하다가 불현듯 들이닥치듯 찾아와 써진 노래라고 소개합니다. 아직 때가 아닌 것 같아 정식 발매 시기는 알 수 없지만 공연을 통해 먼저 들려주겠다는 마음을 전합니다.
talks.transcript: 어 이번 노래는 미발매곡인데 그 '넘어'라는 정규 앨범에는 데모로 수록이 되어 있습니다. '자장'이라는 곡인데요. 음 이 곡이 쓴 곡이 있고 써진 곡이 있는 것 같아요. '그러려니' 같은 곡도 갑자기 그냥 훅 써진 곡이었고 지금 들려드릴 '자장'이라는 노래도 써진 노래입니다. 정말 들이닥치듯이 제게 찾아왔는데 음 세상을 떠난 사람을 생각하고 있다가 들이닥쳤어요. 그래서 쓰게 된 곡이고 아직 때가 아닌 것 같아서 발매는 언제 할지 모르는 상황입니다. 그러면 '자장'을 들려드릴게요.
talks.translation_en: Um, the next song is an unreleased track, but it was included as a demo on my full-length album, *Beyond*. It's called 'Lullaby'. Well, I feel like there are songs that you actively write, and songs that are just written through you. 'Such is Life' was also a song that just came out all of a sudden, and the song I'm about to sing now, 'Lullaby', is another song that was written that way. It truly came to me like a sudden rush. I was thinking of someone who had departed this world, and it just rushed over me. That's how it came to be written, and because it doesn't feel like the right time yet, I don't know when it will be released. Then... I'll play 'Lullaby' for you.

talks.summary_ko: 자신을 살린 곡들 중 가장 격정적인 곡들을 모아 메들리로 엮었다고 소개합니다. 사랑이라는 감정이 하루를 뒤흔들고 폭풍처럼 몰아칠 때 곡을 쓰며 버텨냈음을 밝히며, 메들리 '사랑을 파괴하는 순간'을 들려주겠다고 전합니다.
talks.transcript: 이제 저를 살린 곡 중 가장 격정적인 곡들을 메들리로 모아 보았습니다. 아 사랑. 사랑은 도대체 무엇이길래 이다지도 하루를 들었다 놨다 나를 살렸다가 죽였다가 왜 그러는 것이냐. 그 상대가 문제라기보다 그 사랑 속에 있는 내가 문제인 거죠. 너무나 폭풍 같아요. 그래서 종종 그런 노래들을 써서 살아남았고 그 노래들 이름하여 '사랑을 파괴하는 순간'이라는 메들리 들려드릴게요.
talks.translation_en: Now, I have gathered the most passionate songs among those that saved me into a medley. Ah, love. What on earth is love that it lifts me up and drops me down like this throughout the day, bringing me to life and then killing me—why does it do that? Rather than the other person being the problem, it's me inside that love who is the problem. It feels so much like a storm. So, I often wrote those songs to survive, and I will share those songs with you in a medley titled 'Moments That Destroy Love.'

talks.summary_ko: 곡의 가장 원초적이고 날것 그대로의 모습을 보여주기 위해 피아노와 단둘이 진행하는 공연을 기획했다고 설명합니다. 결국 자신을 살린 것은 관객들의 애정이라는 감사를 전하며, D-flat 키로 작곡된 마지막 두 곡을 끝으로 인사를 전합니다.
talks.transcript: 어, 저를 살린 노래들을 모아서 들려드리는 공연이었는데요. 피아노랑 둘이 하게 된 이유는 가장 곡의 처음, 날것의 처음을 보여드리고 싶었어요. 제가 뭐 모든 곡을 피아노로만 작업하는 건 아니지만 피아노가 가장 가까운 악기이고, 음, 처음 곡을 만들 때의 정말 얘랑 저랑만 있어서 다른 뭐 편곡을 어떻게 해서, 편곡은 저는 좀 옷차림으로 생각을 하는데 그 스타일링을 좀 덜어내고 정말 이렇게 맨몸과 음악만 있는 느낌의 공연을 만들고 싶어서 이런 컨셉을 만들어 봤고요. 그래서 저를 살린 노래들을 고르고 보니 이 곡들이 저를 살린 또 다른 이유는 들어주시는 분들의 애정이다. 그 힘이 없으면 음악을 제가 계속 했고 곡을 썼었더라도 이렇게까지 나를 살릴 수는 없었을 것이다라고까지 생각이 가더라고요. 진짜 이번에 다시 새겼어요. 이, 제가 음악을 살다가 음악을 만들고 그 음악을 만들고 부르면서 다시 살아나고, 이 흐름을 만드는 사람들이 여러분이라서 진짜 원천적인 존재들이구나라는 생각을 했습니다. 그래서 다시 한번 너무나 감사드리고, 마지막 D플랫 키의 두 곡 들려드리면서 저는 인사드리도록 하겠습니다.
talks.translation_en: This concert was about sharing the songs that saved me. The reason I decided to do this solely with the piano was because I wanted to show you the very beginning of the songs—the raw, initial state. While I don't compose all my songs exclusively on the piano, it is the instrument closest to me. When I first create a song, it's truly just the piano and me. Arrangements are something I view like clothing or styling, and I wanted to strip away that styling to create a performance that feels bare, with just my raw self and the music. Looking back after choosing the songs that saved me, I realized another reason they were able to save me was the love from all of you listening. Without that power, even if I kept doing music and writing songs, they wouldn't have been able to save me like this. It truly resonated with me again this time: living my life, writing music, and finding life again through creating and singing that music—the people who create this flow are you all, and you are truly the fundamental source of it. So thank you all once again so very much. I will perform the final two songs in the key of D-flat and say my farewells.

talks.summary_ko: 공연 3일 전 심한 목 담과 편도선 부종으로 노래를 부를 수 없어 취소 위기까지 겪었던 심정을 솔직히 털어놓았습니다. 힘든 상황 속에서도 무사히 공연을 끝마치게 해준 관객들에게 깊은 감사를 전하며, 받은 온기와 에너지를 담아 마지막 곡 '숨'으로 보답하겠다는 다짐을 전합니다.
talks.transcript: 감사합니다. 눈물이 나네요. 코로만 우는 줄 알았는데... 제가 그 뭐 스토리로 보셨던 분들도 있겠어요. 3일 전에 갑자기 담, 목에 담이 온 거예요. 근데 그게 웃을 담이 아니었어요. 진짜 이렇게 가만히 서 있을 수밖에 없었고 노래할 수가 없었어요. 노래를 하려면 굉장히 많은 근육이 쓰인다는 걸 다시 한번 배웠고, 피아노는 어떻게 어떻게 칠 수 있었는데 노래를 할 수 없어서 취소도 이제 긴급 회의를 하고 일단 병원에 가서 주사 치료를 받고... 근데 주사가 너무 아프더라고요. 맞다가 실신하고 막 그랬어요. 그게 목요일 날 있었던 일입니다. 그리고 그리고 금요일 날 이제 일어났는데 목은 그래도 조금이라도 이렇게 돌릴 수 있는 상황이 됐는데 편도가 또 이렇게 부은 거예요. 그래서 또 소리가 지금처럼 나왔어요, 되게 이렇게 무겁게. 망했다. 이거는 좀 피아노와 청아한 가성이 특히 매력인 공연인데, 망했다. 그리고선 이제 취소는 안 할 순 있겠지만 퀄리티가 너무 떨어지겠다, 저 막 너무 속상하고 아쉬웠거든요. 하... 정말 연습도 정말정말 많이 했는데 너무 너무 아쉽고 죄송하고 그랬어요. 근데 네, 끝났네요. 진짜 너무너무 감사합니다. 이게 진짜 뭐 가서 공연이 뭐라고 여러분들 이렇게 덜덜 떨면서... 뭐... 근데 뭐 이것도 살아가는 방식이고 제가 세상에 빛과 온기를 더하는 방식이라고 믿으며, 오늘 이번 공연으로 얻은 에너지를 다음 활동에 정말 아낌없이 듬뿍 넣어서 제가 또다시 무너지려고 할 때 잊지 않고 잘 살아남아 보겠습니다. 그래서 여러분들한테 다시 돌려드릴게요. 숨으로.
talks.translation_en: Thank you. Tears are coming out. I thought I only cried through my nose... Some of you might have seen it on my story. Three days ago, my neck suddenly seized up with severe muscle spasms. But it was no laughing matter. I really couldn't do anything but stand completely still, and I couldn't sing at all. I learned once again that singing requires so many muscles. I could somehow manage to play the piano, but couldn't sing, so we even held an emergency meeting about canceling the show. First, I went to the hospital to receive injection treatment. But the injection was so painful; I actually passed out while getting it. That was what happened on Thursday. And then when I woke up on Friday, while I could at least turn my neck a little bit, my tonsils were swollen like this. So my voice came out sounding like it does now, very heavy. I thought, 'I'm ruined. This concert is supposed to be highlighted especially by piano and clear, pure falsetto, but I'm ruined.' Even if we didn't cancel, I worried the quality would drop so much, so I was really upset and devastated. Sigh... I practiced really, really hard, so I felt so regretful and apologetic. But well, it's done now. Thank you so, so much. I wonder what performing even is, to have me trembling like this in front of you all... But I believe this is my way of living, and my way of adding light and warmth to the world. I will generously pour all the energy I received from this concert into my future activities, and whenever I feel like collapsing again, I won't forget this and will survive well. And I will return it all to you. Through 'Breath'...

While the people I miss only keep growing
Even if I hold no lingering attachments to severed ties
I simply cannot help the yearning in my heart
The people I meet grow fewer in number
While the people I miss only keep growing
Even if I hold no lingering attachments to severed ties
This longing heart...
Mmm, ah, ooh
Just letting it be
Drooping shoulders weighed down by weariness
Each harboring a different unspoken story
Hiding beneath umbrellas to escape the pouring rain
Taking fragile shelter

lines.original: 미처 가리지 못한 발과 양말 보며 한숨만
lines.romanized: Micheo gariji mothan balgwa yangmal bomyeo hansumman
lines.translation_en: Sighing at soaked feet and socks left unprotected
Embracing the damp, worn-out routines of life

lines.original: Why do you do such a stupid thing, you know
lines.romanized: Why do you do such a stupid thing, you know
lines.translation_en: Why do you do such a foolish thing to yourself, you know

lines.original: 피하지 못할 일도 있는 거야, 때가 타면
lines.romanized: Pihaji mothal ildo inneun geoya, ttaega tamyeon
lines.translation_en: Some downpours simply cannot be dodged, and as stains accumulate
The dream slowly fades into blur
Washing away the lingering regrets dissolved in this rain
Yet just when I start to forget, your phantom reappears
Brushing past me with a fluttering hem, crying out loud
It rains, the rain is pouring down
It rains
Everyone, open your mouths wide!
One, two, three, four

lines.original: Why do you stop and be a child who
lines.romanized: Why do you stop and be a child who
lines.translation_en: Why do you freeze and revert to an innocent child who
Could never bear it all in silence
Just like a wild flower in the storm

lines.original: 한 반경 안에 아직 나이를 먹지 못하고
lines.romanized: Han bangyeong ane ajik naireul meokji mothago
lines.translation_en: Trapped in this small radius, never truly growing up

lines.original: 어른의 탈을 쓰고 소리 죽여 울고 있네
lines.romanized: Eoreunui tareul sseugo sori jugyeo ulgo inne
lines.translation_en: Wearing the mask of adulthood, weeping in muffled silence
Still, I just want to run and play
Deep down, I still want to play
I still want to play, free of burdens
I still yearn to play under the rain
One, two! The rain falls!
The rain pours down, it rains
Everyone, sing it out!
Hey, one, two, three, four
Ah~
One, two, three, four
Ah~
A dying, barren island
Appears ever so peaceful
If someone were to ask me
I'd simply reply that I am doing fine

lines.original: Clouds are high in the sky
lines.romanized: Clouds are high in the sky
lines.translation_en: Gathering clouds hang high across the sky
Heralding the coming storm
Pouring waters over my parched, untilled earth
Until everything spills beyond its bounds
I give thanks, O gracious God

lines.original: I shall not be in want
lines.romanized: I shall not be in want
lines.translation_en: I truly shall lack for nothing
Filled forevermore with joy
Thank you, yet it overwhelms my spirit
A flood has already swept over my soul

lines.original: So please make it hold the rain
lines.romanized: So please make it hold the rain
lines.translation_en: So please, let the downpour cease
Oh I thank You, gracious God

lines.original: I shall not be in want
lines.romanized: I shall not be in want
lines.translation_en: I know I shall not want
Embraced by that warmth evermore
Thank you, but it is more than I can bear
The waters have already submerged my fragile heart

lines.original: So please make it hold the rain
lines.romanized: So please make it hold the rain
lines.translation_en: So please, let the pouring rain hold back
Hold back the rain
Stay the falling rain
Hold back this storm
A quiet, fading island
Settles into peaceful silence
Thank You, merciful God

lines.original: I shall not be in want
lines.romanized: I shall not be in want
lines.translation_en: I shall never be in want
Carrying that hope evermore
Thank You, yet it is all too overwhelming
A deluge has already flooded my world

lines.original: So please make it hold the rain
lines.romanized: So please make it hold the rain
lines.translation_en: So please make the skies hold back the rain

lines.original: So please make it hold the rain
lines.romanized: So please make it hold the rain
lines.translation_en: I pray, hold the rain
Hold back the rain
The rain
Hold the rain

songs.title: 욕심 (please be greedy)

lines.translation_en: I need nothing else
Not even the glittering treasures of this world
Nor any grand, illustrious place
Other than you, I have no desires
Just yearn for me

lines.original: 너 가진 게 혹시 줄라 해도
lines.romanized: Neo gajin ge hoksi julla haedo
lines.translation_en: Even if everything you have begins to fade away
Even if we look utterly broken and worn right now
Please, covet me to your heart's fullest content

lines.original: 너의 바다 위에 내가 눕고 싶어
lines.romanized: Neoui bada wie naega nupgo sipeo
lines.translation_en: I want to lie upon your ocean

lines.original: 네 눈물을 모두 받아 마실 거야
lines.romanized: Ne nunmureul modu bada masil geoya
lines.translation_en: And drink in every single drop of your tears
Please, take me
Please be greedy with me
If my devotion dares to reach for you
Please be happy with me
Bask fully in my love

lines.original: 너의 아픔 곁에 내가 앉고 싶어
lines.romanized: Neoui apeum gyeote naega ango sipeo
lines.translation_en: I want to sit right beside your pain

lines.original: 마지막 한 사람 그게 바로 나야
lines.romanized: Majimak han saram geuge baro naya
lines.translation_en: The very last one left for you—that is me
Take me completely
Please become everything
Please become all that I desire
Covet me endlessly
Desiring me more than anyone in this whole world
Carry me over to your quiet island
From my head down to my toes

songs.context_injected: 아티스트는 자신의 곡들 중 각자의 방식으로 가장 찬란하게 빛나는 세 곡을 묶어 연주하겠다고 소개합니다. 화려하고 빛나는 요소들을 사랑하는 본인의 감성을 담아 다음 무대를 열어갑니다.

lines.translation_en: Let's run away
It feels like we just have to go anywhere
Looks like you might burst into tears any second
It's okay, let's just go
Let's lay down our worries for a while
And pack our bags light instead
We can cry all our tears out and come back
Let's not overthink a single thing while we're there
I'll be right here by your side like this
Whenever you reach out your hand, I'll hold it tight
Wherever we end up, what is there to fear?
No matter where our path leads
Because we hold each other so tightly
Just having you is more than enough for me
Look at me, will you meet my eyes?

lines.original: 너의 얼굴 위에 빛이 스며들 때까지
lines.romanized: Neoui eolgul wie bichi seomyeodeul ttaekkaji
lines.translation_en: Until gentle light seeps onto your weary face
Let's leave right now, this very moment
Let's run away
It doesn't even have to be far away
Anywhere is fine with me, as long as it's with you

lines.original: 너의 맘이 편할 수 있는 곳
lines.romanized: Neoui mami pyeonhal su inneun got
lines.translation_en: A place where your heart can finally breathe easy
Just tell me wherever that might be
I'll be right here with you like this
Reach out, and I'll take your hand
Wherever we rest, what is there to fear?
Wherever we may go
Because we hold each other so firmly
Let's give it a try, shall we even run?
Wherever it is, whatever it takes

lines.original: 내가 옆에 있을게 마음껏 울어도 돼
lines.romanized: Naega yeope isseulge maeumkkeot ureodo dwae
lines.translation_en: I'll stay right by you, cry as much as your heart needs
And after that, let's return bravely
It's okay to feel exhausted, I will hold you
It's all right if you're a bit slow, if you walk slowly

lines.original: 나만은 너랑 갈 거야 어디든 당연해
lines.romanized: Namaneun neorang gal geoya eodideun dang-yeonhae
lines.translation_en: I will surely walk with you, anywhere at all without question
Let's go together, hand in hand
I love you, will you meet my gaze?

lines.original: 너의 얼굴 위에 빛이 스며들 때까지
lines.romanized: Neoui eolgul wie bichi seomyeodeul ttaekkaji
lines.translation_en: Until sunlight warms your face once again
Let's go, right this minute
Let's run away
Morning arrives heavily,
and alone, drenched in yesterday,
there is no sign of pity
for someone like me.
In tears that feel overwhelmingly heavy,
the fever of hollowed emotions fades.
Even while swallowing down frustration,
the reason I cling on foolishly once more
is that I want hope,
I want sunlight,
I want the wind,
I want love,
I want wings,

lines.romanized: Ooh ooh ooh natseon bome haebangeul malhae
lines.translation_en: Ooh, speak of liberation in this unfamiliar spring.
Dda rarararara dda rarara ddaa
Saying that I'm doing well
How could that have been sincere?
The words that everything will be alright,
I can't even feel them anymore
I swallow hope with such heavy effort
Yet not even a single piece
Though I know not when it might come true

lines.original: 한 번만 더 마지막으로 희망을 원해
lines.romanized: han beonman deo majimageuro huimangeul wonhae
lines.translation_en: Just once more, for the last time, I long for hope
I yearn for sunlight
I yearn for the breeze
I yearn for love
I yearn for wings
I yearn for life
I yearn for happiness
Ttararararara tta rararara
Just once more, for the last time
Just once more
Hope (passionate vocalization and cries)
Saying that I'm doing well
I want to say it with a smile
Just once more, for the last time
I yearn for hope
I want it, I long for it
I yearn for life, I yearn for happiness
Just once more, for the very last time
Just once more, for the very last time
Just once more
I yearn for life
I yearn for happiness

songs.title: 자장 (from beyond)

lines.original: 자 자 자 자 자 자 자 자 자 자 자 자 자 자 자 자
lines.romanized: ja ja ja ja ja ja ja ja ja ja ja ja ja ja ja ja
lines.translation_en: Hush, hush, sleep, sleep, lullaby...

lines.original: 자 자 자 자 자 자 자 자
lines.romanized: ja ja ja ja ja ja ja ja
lines.translation_en: Hush now, sleep gently, my dear...
Please don't cry anymore
I am alright where I am now
It is all in the past now
Please dry your tears
For I cannot physically embrace and soothe your trembling body from here
I cannot even wipe the sorrow stained upon your cheek
Nor can I hold your sweaty, weary hands
So please let me go, as I remain helpless beyond
Sleep now, sleep...
Since I cannot reach you
Even if it is a fallen body upon the earth

lines.original: 멍이 든 마음이라 손 쓸 수도 못 해
lines.romanized: meongi deun maeumira son sseul sudo mot hae
lines.translation_en: A bruised heart that I cannot even mend

lines.original: 그러니 이제 그만 울고 자 자
lines.romanized: geureoni ije geuman ulgo ja ja
lines.translation_en: So please, weep no more and rest now, hush...
Hush, go to sleep...
Sleep gently now...
Drift into sleep...
Hush, my dear, rest now...
Sleep peacefully...
Now let me go, and finally fall into peaceful sleep

songs.context_injected: 다음으로 부를 미발매곡 '자장'은 세상을 떠난 이를 생각하다가 불현듯 들이닥치듯 찾아와 써진 노래라고 소개합니다. 아직 때가 아닌 것 같아 정식 발매 시기는 알 수 없지만 공연을 통해 먼저 들려주겠다는 마음을 전합니다.

lines.translation_en: It's fine even if I don't meet you

lines.original: 아니 아예 안 만나는 게 좋겠어
lines.romanized: Ani aye an mannaneun ge jokkesseo
lines.translation_en: No, it might actually be better never to meet at all

lines.original: 만약 널 코앞에서 마주치게 되면 내 표정 무너지게 될 거야
lines.romanized: Manyak neol koap-eseo majuchige doemyeon nae pyojeong muneojige doel geoya
lines.translation_en: Because if I run into you right in front of me, all my composure will crumble

lines.original: Because I'm just out of control
lines.romanized: Because I'm just out of control
lines.translation_en: Because I'm just out of control
It's so obvious I wouldn't even be able to look you in the eye

lines.original: 내 자린 그냥 여기 이렇게 멀찍이 보이지 않는 곳에서
lines.romanized: Nae jarin geunyang yeogi ireoke meoljjigi boiji anneun gos-eseo
lines.translation_en: My place is just right here, far away like this, in a place unseen

lines.original: 순전히 너만을 네가 어디서 무얼 하든 이유 같은 거 없이 널 좋아하는 이
lines.romanized: Sunjeonhi neomaneul nega eodiseo mueol hadeun iyu gateun geo eopsi neol joahaneun i
lines.translation_en: Purely for you, no matter where you are or what you do, someone who loves you without any reason

lines.original: 순순히 너에게 내 시간과 마음을 바쳐 너를 아는 데 몽땅 써 버릴
lines.romanized: Sunsunhi neoege nae sigangwa ma-eumeul bachyeo neoreul aneun de mongttang sseo beoril
lines.translation_en: Willingly dedicating all my time and heart to you, spending it all just to know you
This person, this one

lines.original: 정말 좋아 사실 난 바빠 정말이야
lines.romanized: Jeongmal joa sasil nan bappa jeongmariya
lines.translation_en: I really love you; honestly, I'm busy, it's the truth

lines.original: 일 분 일 초가 모자라는 몸꼴인
lines.romanized: Il bun il choga mojaranneun momkkorin
lines.translation_en: In a frantic state where every minute and second is scarce

lines.original: 그런 내가 세상 다음 남인 너 때문에 하고 있는 이 짓들을 봐
lines.romanized: Geureon naega sesang da-eum namin neo ttaemune hago inneun i jitdeureul bwa
lines.translation_en: Look at what I'm doing, for someone who is practically a total stranger to me

lines.original: Because I'm just out of control
lines.romanized: Because I'm just out of control
lines.translation_en: Because I'm just out of control

lines.original: 한심하다 해도 이 마음을 어쩌면 좋아
lines.romanized: Hansimhada haedo i ma-eumeul eojjeomyeon joa
lines.translation_en: Even if called pathetic, what can I do with this heart?

lines.original: 고단해 지친 내 일상 속의 유일한 에너지 욕을 먹어도 난 좋아
lines.romanized: Godanhae jichin nae ilsang sogui yuilhan eneoji yogeul meogeodo nan joa
lines.translation_en: The only energy in my exhausting, weary daily life; even if blamed, I still love it

lines.original: 순전히 너만을 네가 어디서 무얼 하든 이유 같은 거 없이 널 좋아하는 이
lines.romanized: Sunjeonhi neomaneul nega eodiseo mueol hadeun iyu gateun geo eopsi neol joahaneun i
lines.translation_en: Purely for you, no matter where you are or what you do, someone who loves you without any reason

lines.original: 순순히 너에게 내 시간과 마음을 바쳐 너를 아는 데 몽땅 써 버릴
lines.romanized: Sunsunhi neoege nae sigangwa ma-eumeul bachyeo neoreul aneun de mongttang sseo beoril
lines.translation_en: Willingly dedicating all my time and heart to you, spending it all just to know you
This person, this one

lines.original: 네가 정말 좋아 어쩔 줄 몰라 나는
lines.romanized: Nega jeongmal joa eojjeol jul molla naneun
lines.translation_en: I like you so much, I don't know what to do with myself
I like you so very much

lines.original: 네가 정말 좋아 어쩔 줄 몰라 나는
lines.romanized: Nega jeongmal joa eojjeol jul molla naneun
lines.translation_en: I like you so much, I don't know what to do with myself
I like you so very much

lines.original: 내가 조금 더 기억에 봐 줄게 나쁜 짓만 하지 마
lines.romanized: Naega jogeum deo gieoge bwa julge nappeun jinman haji ma
lines.translation_en: I'll keep looking out for you in my memories, just don't do bad things
I won't ask for much
Could you just wave your hand once for me?

lines.original: 순전히 너만을 네가 어디서 무얼 하든 이유 같은 거 없이 널 좋아하는 이
lines.romanized: Sunjeonhi neomaneul nega eodiseo mueol hadeun iyu gateun geo eopsi neol joahaneun i
lines.translation_en: Purely for you, no matter where you are or what you do, someone who loves you without any reason

lines.original: 순순히 너에게 내 시간과 마음을 바쳐 너를 아는 데 몽땅 써 버릴
lines.romanized: Sunsunhi neoege nae sigangwa ma-eumeul bachyeo neoreul aneun de mongttang sseo beoril
lines.translation_en: Willingly dedicating all my time and heart to you, spending it all just to know you
This person, this one
I like you so very much
I like you so very much
I don't know what to do with myself
I like you so very much

lines.original: 네가 정말 좋아 어쩔 줄 몰라 나는 네가 정말 네가 정...
lines.romanized: Nega jeongmal joa eojjeol jul molla naneun nega jeongmal nega jeong...
lines.translation_en: I like you so much, I don't know what to do, I really... I really...
I like you
(Vocalizing)
One, two, three, four, yes
I really like you
I truly love you all so much
I really love you

songs.title: 당신을 파괴하는 순간 (The Moment When I Destroy You)

lines.original: 그래 그 말 맞아 난 변했어
lines.romanized: geurae geu mal maja nan byeonhaesseo
lines.translation_en: Yes, you're right, I have changed

lines.original: 그래 네 말 맞아 내 맘 떠났어
lines.romanized: geurae ne mal maja nae mam tteonasseo
lines.translation_en: Yes, you're right, my heart has left you
(humming)
Even this moment feels like a waste

lines.original: 네 말 다 들을 수 없어 어차피 너 얘기해봤자 변한 건 없을 거야
lines.romanized: ne mal da deureul su eopseo eochapi neo yaegihaebwatja byeonhan geon eopseul geoya
lines.translation_en: I can't listen to all your words, whatever you say won't change a thing
Nothing will change
Holding onto you only made me lose everything

lines.original: 그런 질문에 가진 미련조차 지금은 기적 인정해 줘
lines.romanized: geureon jilmune gajin miryeonjocha jigeumeun gijeok injeonghae jwo
lines.translation_en: Even that lingering regret, please just let it end now, accept it
I was driven mad

lines.original: 얼굴 지워 아무 때문에 주저앉지 않을
lines.romanized: eolgul jiwo amu ttaemune jujeoanjji aneul
lines.translation_en: Erase your face, I won't collapse for anything
Don't turn into worthless baggage like trash

lines.original: 사랑해 바보 같잖아 더 말하지 마
lines.romanized: saranghae babo gatjana deo malhaji ma
lines.translation_en: "I love you" sounds so foolish now, don't say another word

songs.context_injected: 자신을 살린 곡들 중 가장 격정적인 곡들을 모아 메들리로 엮었다고 소개합니다. 사랑이라는 감정이 하루를 뒤흔들고 폭풍처럼 몰아칠 때 곡을 쓰며 버텨냈음을 밝히며, 메들리 '사랑을 파괴하는 순간'을 들려주겠다고 전합니다.

lines.translation_en: The one and only person of my life
Though it might hurt if we meet
We are like water,
Bound to end up loving each other in the end
Everything lingering from the long time past,
Throw it all away and forget it completely
So we can look at each other beautifully once again,
How wonderful that would be
From the very beginning once again,
I want to reach you
The one and only person of my life
The one and only person of my life
In my lifetime
I guess we just don't fit together
In the end, yet again like this
Revealing the very bottom of ourselves
Hitting, stabbing each other, and writhing in pain
Upon our contorted, grimacing faces
Any trace of the love we shared is nowhere to be found
With voices screaming at the top of our lungs
Resentment endlessly spreads between us
Did we fall in love
Only to wage war as our feelings ran deeper?
Leaving even one more agonizing scar

lines.original: 승부를 볼 때 끝을 내보아도 보란 듯 울어도 되겠지
lines.romanized: Seungbureul bol ttae kkeuteul naeboado boran deut ureodo doegetji
lines.translation_en: When we reach that bitter showdown, even if we bring an end and cry in defiance, would it be enough?
Upon our distorted, agonized faces
Traces of having once loved each other have completely vanished
Through voices screaming and tearing apart
Endless resentment spills out and consumes us
Even in the briefest moment of anger
I couldn't just easily look the other way

lines.original: 버틴 만큼 버틴 것 같은데 워
lines.romanized: beotin mankeum beotin geot gateunde wo
lines.translation_en: I feel like I've endured as much as I could bear, whoa

lines.original: 세상의 끝 한 걸음 앞에 우리를 기다리네
lines.romanized: sesang-ui kkeut han georeum ape urireul gidarine
lines.translation_en: Just one step before the end of the world awaits us
Even tears are of no use now
This is where we end
It hurts so much—how can parting be this effortless?
The very instant we turn away, we become strangers
The word 'us' simply fades away
Burning sensations surge up
Striking me with scorching pain
You linger like a fading dream
Hiding deep inside my memories
Tears can change nothing now
We've reached our absolute end
The word 'us' vanishes into thin air
The sacred word 'us' is disappearing
We are fading
We are being erased
Saying goodbye turned out to be so simple
This is as far as we go

songs.title: 구애

lines.translation_en: I told you that I love you, didn't I?

lines.original: 안 들려요 왜 못 들은 척해요
lines.romanized: An deullyeoyo wae mot deureun cheokhaeyo
lines.translation_en: Can't you hear me? Why do you pretend not to hear?

lines.original: 당신을 바라보는 내 눈빛 다 알잖아요
lines.romanized: Dangsineul baraboneun nae nunbit da aljanayo
lines.translation_en: You know so well the gaze with which I look at you

lines.original: 안 보여요 왜 못 본 척하냐고요
lines.romanized: An boyeoyo wae mot bon cheokhanyagoyo
lines.translation_en: Can't you see it? Why do you keep pretending not to notice?

lines.original: 난 언제나 그랬어 당신만 쭉 바라봤어
lines.romanized: Nan eonjena geuraesseo dangsinman jjuk barabwasseo
lines.translation_en: I've always been this way, looking only towards you
You might get exasperated and ask what you should do about it
Because I truly had no clue what you might love
I tried dressing myself up this way and that, looking quite ridiculous
I just want to be loved
So much more, more than anything
Embroidered with words of 'I love you'

lines.original: 그 말도 너에게는 평생 듣고 싶어
lines.romanized: Geu maldo neoegeneun pyeongsaeng deutgo sipeo
lines.translation_en: I want to hear those words from you for the rest of my life
I crave hearing it again and again
How long do I have to wait?
Until when?

lines.original: I wanna hold onto your heart
lines.romanized: I wanna hold onto your heart
lines.translation_en: I wanna hold onto your heart

lines.original: I wanna hold onto your heart
lines.romanized: I wanna hold onto your heart
lines.translation_en: I wanna hold onto your heart

lines.original: I wanna hold onto your heart
lines.romanized: I wanna hold onto your heart
lines.translation_en: I wanna hold onto your heart

lines.original: 난 언제나 불렀어 당신을 위한 노랠 써
lines.romanized: Nan eonjena bulleosseo dangsineul wihan norael sseo
lines.translation_en: I've always sung, writing song after song just for you
You might wonder and ask when I ever did that
Because I truly had no clue what kind of music you'd love

lines.original: 이런저런 노래 별의별 노래를 다 불러봤지만
lines.romanized: Ireonjeoreon norae byeorui-byeol noraereul da bulleobwatjiman
lines.translation_en: I sang all kinds of tunes, every single song I could imagine
I just want to be loved by you
So much more, with all your heart
Embroidered with confessions of 'I love you'

lines.original: 그 말도 너에게는 평생 듣고 싶어
lines.romanized: Geu maldo neoegeneun pyeongsaeng deutgo sipeo
lines.translation_en: I want to hear those words from you for my entire life
I want to hear it over and over
How long must I wait for you?
Until when?
I love you, more deeply than anyone else
Woven with every ounce of 'I love you'

lines.original: 그 말도 너에게는 평생 해주고 싶어
lines.romanized: Geu maldo neoegeneun pyeongsaeng haejugo sipeo
lines.translation_en: I want to confess that to you for the rest of my days
I want to say it to you endlessly
Even if you never recognize it, goodbye—
I'll never give up on you
I told you that I love you, didn't I?
Can't you hear me? I am telling you right now

lines.original: I wanna hold onto your heart
lines.romanized: I wanna hold onto your heart
lines.translation_en: I wanna hold onto your heart

songs.context_injected: 곡의 가장 원초적이고 날것 그대로의 모습을 보여주기 위해 피아노와 단둘이 진행하는 공연을 기획했다고 설명합니다. 결국 자신을 살린 것은 관객들의 애정이라는 감사를 전하며, D-flat 키로 작곡된 마지막 두 곡을 끝으로 인사를 전합니다.

lines.translation_en: Your love revives me once again

lines.original: 내가 버렸던 하루를 주워서 너른 품 안에 꼭 안아 주더니
lines.romanized: naega beoryeotdeon harureul juwoseo neoreun pum ane kkok ana judeoni
lines.translation_en: You gathered up the day I discarded, and held it tightly in your wide embrace
And gently placed it back into my mouth
What I couldn't swallow and ended up spilling over
Wiping it away quietly and waiting patiently
To you,
I want to give a smile,
I want to hold you in my arms,

lines.original: 고개 숙인 채 그만 흐르는 눈물
lines.romanized: gogae sugin chae geuman heureuneun nunmul
lines.translation_en: Yet with my head bowed down, the tears simply keep flowing
My heart, unable to move on, keeps faltering
When even I myself cannot bear who I am
You revive me yet again
Raising me up and meeting my eyes
Your love breathes life back into me once more

lines.original: 나의 이 밤에 긴 숨이 흐르네
lines.romanized: naui i bame gin sumi heureune
lines.translation_en: Across my night, a long, deep breath finally flows
Mmm-

songs.title: 살리네(Revive) Reprise + City Sunset

lines.translation_en: Your love revives me and keeps me breathing
Your love is what truly brings me back to life
Picking up the day I had almost given up on
Gathering up the pieces of the day I nearly threw away
At sunset, with both eyes turned red
Wrinkling a face grown dry and weary
The sun sinks away into stifled sighs
Here under the roofs, sheltering like my umbrella

lines.original: 너만 힘든 거 아냐 모두 마음에 아픔
lines.romanized: Neoman himdeun geo anya modu maeume apeum
lines.translation_en: You're not the only one struggling; everyone holds pain in their heart

lines.original: 너의 한숨 애써 숨기며 미소 짓지 저 노을처럼
lines.romanized: Neoui hansum aesseo sumgimyeo miso jitji jeo noeulcheoreom
lines.translation_en: Trying hard to swallow back sighs, putting on a faint smile like the fading dusk

lines.original: 그래 오늘도 살아내야지 지켜낼 것이 많은 참 많은
lines.romanized: Geurae oneuldo saranaeyaji jikyeonael geosi maneun cham maneun
lines.translation_en: Yes, I have to endure through today again, with so much left to protect and uphold

lines.original: 나로 인해 또 누군가가 아픈 게 난 싫어
lines.romanized: Naro inhae tto nugungaga apeun ge nan sileo
lines.translation_en: I hate the thought of anyone else hurting because of me

lines.original: 사실 오늘 하루도 버거웠지 내 맘조차 지키지 못했는걸
lines.romanized: Sasil oneul harudo beogeowotji nae mamjocha jikiji mothaenneungeol
lines.translation_en: To be honest, today was overwhelmingly heavy; I couldn't even guard my own heart

lines.original: 초라한 발걸음 끝에 다 내려놓고 싶은 날
lines.romanized: Chorahan balgeoreum kkeute da naeryeonoko sipeun nal
lines.translation_en: At the end of these weary, crumbling footsteps, on a day when I just wanted to let everything go

songs.context_injected: 공연 3일 전 심한 목 담과 편도선 부종으로 노래를 부를 수 없어 취소 위기까지 겪었던 심정을 솔직히 털어놓았습니다. 힘든 상황 속에서도 무사히 공연을 끝마치게 해준 관객들에게 깊은 감사를 전하며, 받은 온기와 에너지를 담아 마지막 곡 '숨'으로 보답하겠다는 다짐을 전합니다.

lines.translation_en: My staggering heart, unable to hold itself together
I try to reach out and hold it, suddenly my eyes open wide
Once again, you bring me back to life
Lifting me up, meeting my eyes
Your love revives me once again

lines.original: 나의 이 밤을 긴 숨이 흐르네
lines.romanized: naui i bameul gin sumi heureune
lines.translation_en: Through this night of mine, a long breath flows
Mmm- mmm-
